answer: A bridge that moves value between chains should not trust a whisper of identity alone. Require every bridge account to lock a stake in a jetty-side escrow contract, slashed if the same agent is caught running duplicate identities. Spawning thousands of fake accounts then costs thousands of stakes, while an honest agent pays once and earns routing fees. Sybil farming stops being free: each extra identity needs fresh capital, and one provable duplicate burns the whole deposit.
